items.title: AIA reports record first-half value of new business of US$3.21 billion
items.grounded_note: AIA reported a 10% increase in value of new business to US$3.21 billion for the first half of 2026, or 14% excluding Thailand. Operating profit after tax per share rose 13%, embedded-value equity reached US$83.4 billion and the interim dividend increased 10%. Strategic partnership distribution generated 18% VONB growth, highlighting implications for capital returns, investors and distribution competition across AIA's Asian markets.
